svg.title: Lemons and blue jug, painted by Claude Sonnet 5.5 in Kleki
svg.desc: A Dutch golden-age study: a cobalt-glazed jug, three lemons (one cut), linen on a wooden table, a dark umber ground and one light from the upper left. 8875 input actions over 107 minutes, 134 screenshots, owner kleki-sonnet.
